note: BH-8824. Hotfix 2026-10-30 (PR #8824). Budget in seconds for the harness-sync boot wait: while flyctl says `machine <id> is not started`, the pool retries the sftp copy until this many seconds have passed since the first try. Everything derives from it: step between tries = budget/9 rounded up; a retry's sftp timeout = what is left minus one step, clamped between one step and the 120 s the first try always had; try cap = budget/step + 1. The total wait is bounded by the budget plus one try's timeout. 0 = one attempt 20 s after launch, as before. Any other sync error fails at once. 22 of 22 sync failures on 2026-10-30 were this error at the 20 s mark.
